incidents.title: 401 authentication failure
incidents.symptom: The coverage request stores no Request Time Off event.
incidents.diagnosis: token_check is rejected and the gateway records token_invalid. A registration POST with no token returns HTTP 401.
incidents.root_cause: The access token is invalid. The lab rejects it before any worker read or coverage call.
incidents.fix: Authenticate the actor again and use a token issued at the current registration epoch.
incidents.prevention: token_check stays first, and the bearer secret is removed from the trace.

incidents.title: 403 authorization failure
incidents.symptom: The worker read is refused and no time-off event is stored.
incidents.root_cause: The REST resource call was injected with HTTP 403. Workday documents that status when the resource or the domain policy blocks the caller. This run injects the status. It does not call Workday.
incidents.fix: Register the resource for the caller and include the caller's groups on the domain policy, then sign in again.
incidents.prevention: A 403 stops the action before reserve_coverage and before Request Time Off.

incidents.title: Missing permission
incidents.symptom: HR does not see the write skill. The tool is not listed.
incidents.diagnosis: gateway_authorize returns not_in_available_to. request-coverage Available To is managers only.
incidents.root_cause: SYN-USER-HANA is in SYN-SG-HR-PARTNER. That group is not on the write skill.
incidents.fix: Leave the write skill limited to managers. Send HR to read-balance.
incidents.prevention: Preflight rejects SYN-SG-EMPLOYEE on the write skill. The story checks that HR can read and still cannot write.

incidents.title: Invalid configuration
incidents.symptom: The gateway does not list the tool.
incidents.diagnosis: The first gateway check returns tenant_alias_missing.
incidents.root_cause: The tenant alias is empty. Agent Gateway requires it. A real tenant alias was not issued for this lab.
incidents.fix: Send the lab org id SYN-ORG-NORTHLINE as the alias on the local stand-in.
incidents.prevention: The alias check fails closed before the token is treated as sufficient.

incidents.title: Schema mismatch
incidents.symptom: The action rejects the body before reading the worker.
incidents.diagnosis: validate_input fails with schema_mismatch because hours arrived as a string.
incidents.root_cause: The request property hours is a number. The payload sent a string. Strict validation does not coerce it.
incidents.prevention: CoverageInput is strict. Preflight still requires a description and a sample on every request property.

incidents.title: Malformed payload
incidents.symptom: The action rejects the body and stores no event.
incidents.diagnosis: validate_input returns malformed_input because client_request_id is absent.
incidents.root_cause: The idempotency field is required. The payload omitted it.
incidents.prevention: The replay store keys on that field. A write without it is refused.

incidents.title: Downstream timeout
incidents.symptom: The coverage call does not finish inside the synchronous limit.
incidents.diagnosis: reserve_coverage is timed_out. The elapsed virtual clock is past 300000 ms. No business-process event is written.
incidents.root_cause: The injected clock jumps by the timeout plus 1 ms on the first coverage attempt. The calendar host is a fixture.
incidents.fix: Stay inside the 5-minute synchronous limit. This lab does not run an asynchronous orchestration.
incidents.prevention: The timeout is checked before a later retry, and Request Time Off is not submitted after a timeout.

incidents.title: Duplicate request
incidents.symptom: A second submit with the same client_request_id returns the original event.
incidents.diagnosis: The idempotency node is replayed. The external call count stays 1 and the event count stays 1.
incidents.root_cause: The key is the actor, the worker, and client_request_id. The client retried that same key.
incidents.fix: Return the stored event. Do not reserve coverage again and do not submit Request Time Off again.
incidents.prevention: The action effect is Idempotent. The lab store enforces it. The store is process memory and does not survive a restart.

incidents.title: Dependency failure
incidents.symptom: The coverage calendar keeps returning an error and no time-off event is stored.
incidents.diagnosis: reserve_coverage records the retry nodes and the code is retry_exhausted.
incidents.root_cause: The fixture fails every attempt. The business process waits until coverage succeeds, so a dead dependency creates no time-off event.
incidents.fix: When the dependency recovers, the same action succeeds on attempt 3 after two failures. Backoff is 10 ms then 20 ms on the virtual clock.
incidents.prevention: Attempts are capped at 3. The business process is not submitted after the dependency is exhausted.

incidents.title: Configuration drift
incidents.symptom: A previously usable token is rejected after the agent registration changes.
incidents.diagnosis: The token is issued, then gateway_authorize returns token_stale.
incidents.root_cause: The token epoch is 1 and the registration epoch is 2. A token from before the registration change does not match the new epoch.
incidents.fix: Discard the old token and call again after registration.
incidents.prevention: Every tool authorization compares issued_epoch with registration_epoch.

lifecycle.field_issue: The write skill was loaded without list_time_off_types. Preflight reports prompt_tool_missing. attach_required_prompts restores the catalog WID, and the repaired package submits one Request Time Off event. This was reproduced in the lab from the prompt-tool rule. It was not observed in a customer tenant.
